Marta — thanks for flagging and for the attachments. I'm escalating to billing ops and tax ops for a quick review. Initial notes:

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-19T08:42:00-04:00

Thanks Karthik. Quick summary from ops after a look:

- Root cause: an ingestion retry duplicated a small subset (~12 calls) of high-cost premium routing during a 10-minute window on 2026-09-14. Two invoices were generated because the retry created a second billing event.
- Proposed remediation: issue a service credit equal to the duplicate line amount (EUR 12,450) and a goodwill credit for EUR 250 to cover any reconciliation overhead. Total credit: EUR 12,700.
- VAT treatment: Because Clearfield is an EU VAT-registered B2B customer and provided a valid VAT ID, the original invoices were zero-rated reverse-charge. For credits, standard practice is to issue a credit note referencing the original invoice numbers and the same reverse-charge notation.

Action items we need from Clearfield to complete the credit note and/or refund:
1) Confirm preference: credit note (applied to next invoice) or bank refund (SEPA) — if bank refund, please provide beneficiary details and bank statement name.
2) Provide VAT registration confirmation (we have a partial doc attached; please send the official VAT cert).
3) Confirm whether you need a split: some AP teams require the service credit as a separate line from goodwill for internal posting.

Ben — please prepare a credit note draft referencing RWD-202609-451/452 and the usage CSV reconciliation. Include one line for the duplicate service charge and a second goodwill line per Marta's request.

Laura Bennett
Billing & Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: preliminary-recon-0901-0930.csv (CSV)]
